alt: Anterior view of the right forearm showing the superficial flexor compartment: biceps brachii and brachioradialis proximally, then pronator teres, flexor carpi radialis, palmaris longus, flexor carpi ulnaris and flexor digitorum superficialis running to the wrist and hand.
caption: Superficial anterior (flexor) compartment of the forearm (OpenStax): biceps brachii, brachioradialis, pronator teres, flexor carpi radialis, palmaris longus, flexor carpi ulnaris and flexor digitorum superficialis.
